dct_description_sm: The objective of this project is to design, develop and implement a general purpose framework for the storage, query, analysis, and visualization of all key relevant environmental data for the Beaufort Sea with specific applications of the determination of design ice loads for offshore platforms and offshore marine operations. Thus, information will be presented in a centralized format. The use of BSED will lead to safe and efficient operations in the Beaufort Sea ensuring that needs of local communities are met. It will ensure that engineering decisions are made with the best available regional information. It becomes a primary point of reference for regional environmental information for regulators responsible for reviewing project applications in the Beaufort Sea. The information on ice conditions will be a major driving factor for decisions related to the types of emergency evacuation systems that must be in place on platforms at sea. Analysis of BSED data provides direct input on the shipping regulations and severity of ice conditions throughout the year in the Beaufort Sea. This information can be used to evaluate required vessel class, windows of operation for both platform supplies and offloading of hydrocarbons, and routes for tankers and supply vessels. The database and analysis of data can be used to identify gaps in important data and knowledge.
